subject: Marketplace partner program transition — incentive alignment & audit prep
messages:
From: aws-partner-program@amazon.com
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: kate.jensen@resellco.com
Date: Tue, 11 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace program change — upcoming commission recalibration (info + ask)

Vanessa / Aditya / Marissa,

Quick heads up: AWS is rolling a partner program update that recalibrates listing credits and co-sell incentives for certain software categories effective 2028-07-01. Early sighting attached (aws_listing_change_summary.pdf).

Key items that affect Redwood:
- Listing-credit pool for infra/serving software will move from a percentage-of-listing to a fixed credit band by SKU.
- Marketplace commission collects differently for annual prepaid vs metered usage; reconciliation windows will shift to monthly end-of-month.
- There will be a short-term transition credit for existing long-term listings, but it requires an audit of realized charges for the prior 12 months.

What we need from you by 2028-04-20:
1) A consolidated export of Redwood marketplace listing/invoice data (SKU-level) for the last 12 months.
2) Confirmation of which SKUs are covered by long-term promotional credits (if any).
3) A point-of-contact to coordinate the audit and the DocuSign amendment.

Kate Jensen (ResellCo) is copied as a downstream reseller affected by the change. AWS can provide a program liaison to expedite the amendment if we identify the SKUs and the expected credit gaps.

I can set up a 30-min alignment call later this week — what’s your availability?

Thanks,
AWS Partner Operations

--
aws_listing_change_summary.pdf (attachment)
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: aws-partner-program@amazon.com, kate.jensen@resellco.com
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 11 Apr 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace program change — upcoming commission recalibration (info + ask)

Thanks for the heads up. We reviewed the summary and agree we need to move quickly.

Action plan proposal from our side:
- Aditya will pull SKU-level billing exports for the last 12 months and deliver a CSV by 2028-04-18.
- Marissa will confirm active promotional SKUs and whether any are tied to prior marketplace credits.
- Ben will validate whether finance needs to treat the transition credit as a contra-revenue item or an invoice-level credit.

For coordination: I will be the main POC for the program amendment. Please send the DocuSign link and any model amendment language. We prefer a single amendment covering both AWS and GCP marketplace structs (if AWS is okay sharing the template) to avoid duplicate redlines.

Availability for a 30-min call: Wed 4/12 9:00-11:00am PT or Thu 4/13 2:00-4:00pm PT.

Vanessa
Head of Strategic Partnerships, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0192

--
(attachment stub referenced: marketplace_playbook_note.txt)
From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai

Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 12 Apr 2028 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace program change — upcoming commission recalibration (info + ask)

Vanessa—
I'll extract the SKU-level exports from our billing warehouse and dump to CSV. A couple of notes so the CSV is audit-ready:
- I'll include invoice_id, invoice_date, sku_id, sku_desc, listing_fee, marketplace_commission, reseller_credit_applied, customer_account_id, usage_units, and markup columns.
- There are two SKUs (ri-inference-small, ri-inference-quant) created mid-2027 that have inconsistent tagging across environments; I'll normalize tags but will include a mapping sheet.
- Expect the first export by COB 2028-04-18. If AWS needs earlier samples for priority SKUs we can push a subset.

Marissa—please flag any SKUs with active long-term credits so I can mark them in the export. Ben—confirm if finance wants a separate reconciliation sheet for deferred revenue adjustments.

Thanks,
Aditya

--
(attachment stub: pending_sku_tag_mappings.xlsx)
From: aws-partner-program@amazon.com
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: kate.jensen@resellco.com
Date: Thu, 13 Apr 2028 11:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace program change — upcoming commission recalibration (info + ask)

Thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround. Two items to confirm:
1) We can accept the consolidated CSV format Aditya described. For the audit we'll need signed confirmation that the export ties to Redwood's accounting ledger (a short cover letter on Redwood letterhead is fine).
2) AWS will produce a short amendment template covering listing-credit transition language and the temporary transition credit. We'll send the DocuSign link once you confirm the POC and provide the CSV.

Links and attachments:
- AWS program guide (public): https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/partner-programs/2028-update
- Draft amendment will be sent as DocuSign: https://docusign.com/r/abcd-efgh-2028

We recommend a joint call to walk through the CSV fields and to confirm reseller SKUs (ResellCo copies also). If you can do Thurs 4/13 at 2:00pm PT we'll send a calendar invite.

Best,
AWS Partner Ops
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: aws-partner-program@amazon.com, kate.jensen@resellco.com
Date: Tue, 18 Apr 2028 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace program change — upcoming commission recalibration (info + ask)

Team — quick status update and owners: 
- Aditya: attach the CSV export (marketplace_billing_export_2027Q4.csv) and the SKU mapping. NOTE: I put the file in our secure Share (link sent separately).
- Marissa: confirm the two long-term promotional SKUs (ri-inference-small, ri-inference-quant). Are there contract clauses that would block auto-amendment?
- Ben: work with finance to draft the one-page cover letter confirming ledger ties. Finance needs to confirm whether the transition credit is contra-revenue or invoice-level before we sign.

Next steps: AWS will send the DocuSign amendment (they said today) — please treat the DocuSign as time-sensitive. We should aim to complete review and sign by 2028-05-02 to capture transition-credit eligibility.

I'll run the Thurs 4/13 alignment call notes into a mutual action plan and drop into the HubSpot deal (RWIN-2028-0431).

Thanks,
Vanessa
